name: 06903 · Stamford, CT
findings: ZIP 06903 (Stamford) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06903 (Stamford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
